Favorite products from FPS26

Farm Progress Show: Editor favorites include products to help farmers save time and money while increasing efficiency and productivity using precision technology, autonomy and AI.

Jen Koukol,Digital EditorSeptember 4, 2026

Walking through the hot Farm Progress Show grounds this year, there was no shortage of products to help farmers be more efficient and save money on the farm. From new field-scouting robots down to wireless Bluetooth microphones, there’s utility and on-farm functionality to help operations of all sizes.

Field scouting robot

TerraScout from TerraClear is a fully autonomous field scouting robot for large-acre row crops. Here are some of its attributes:

It scouts fields for weeds and rocks, and performs stand counts — up to 1,000 acres a day at 15 mph.

It has a 60- or 40-foot boom, with mounted cameras that take millions of photos per acre.

An interactive map has options for rocks and weed pressure.

Bluetooth microphone

The Midland MXT295 Pro is the company’s first wireless Bluetooth microphone, enabling farmers to move in and out of equipment without cables getting in the way. Highlights include:

It has Bluetooth headset and accessory compatibility.

Related:2027 Farm Progress Show returns to Decatur, Ill.

Intercom capability and PA functionality are standard.

The cost is $299.

Solar-powered tractor

The GoSun Moonrider is a plug-in or solar electric tractor that captures energy from flexible solar panels that fold down from a rooftop case. Its features include:

It has a 27-hp electric motor, four-wheel drive and a standard rear PTO with three-point hitch.

One day in the sun provides about an hour of runtime.

A full solar-powered recharge takes several days.

It costs $19,995.

Spray drone

The Independence 19 drone from Revolution Drones was unveiled at this year’s Farm Progress Show, with 78% of their components made in the United States. It features:

It has a 20-gallon tank and three batteries.

It covers 60 to 80 acres in an hour with a 35- to 45-foot swath.

An optional spreader box can seed cover crops.

The price is $46,250.

On-planter seed treatment

The POP-ST from TeeJet and Inflexion Point Technologies is the industry’s first prescriptive on-planter seed treatment system, featuring these attributes:

It can connect to any make or model of planter.

Seed can be treated during planting, applying only what’s needed.

The price is just over $100,000 per unit.

On-the-go application

Case IH SenseApply is a camera system placed on the top of the sprayer cab:

Cameras see 120 to 130 feet ahead of the spraying path.

NDVI detects biomass.

The variable-rate application is in real time.

Jen Koukol

Digital Editor

Jen grew up in south-central Minnesota and graduated from Minnesota State University, Mankato, with a degree in mass communications. She served as a communications specialist for the Minnesota Soybean Growers Association and Minnesota Soybean Research and Promotion Council, and was a book editor before joining the Corn & Soybean Digest staff.

translationZh:
在今年的农场进步展上，尽管天气炎热，但帮助农民提高效率、节省成本的展品层出不穷。从新型田间巡逻机器人到无线蓝牙麦克风，这些产品都能为各种规模的农场提供实用功能。

**田间巡逻机器人**

TerraClear公司的TerraScout是一款专为大面积行栽作物设计的全自主田间巡逻机器人。其特点包括：

- 可巡逻田间杂草和石块，并进行出苗计数——每天可覆盖1000英亩，时速15英里。
- 配备60或40英尺长的吊杆，搭载相机，每英亩可拍摄数百万张照片。
- 交互式地图可显示石块和杂草压力选项。

**蓝牙麦克风**

Midland MXT295 Pro是该公司首款无线蓝牙麦克风，使农民在进出设备时无需担心线缆缠绕。亮点包括：

- 兼容蓝牙耳机和配件。
- 标配对讲功能和公共广播功能。
- 售价299美元。

**太阳能拖拉机**

GoSun Moonrider是一款插电式或太阳能电动拖拉机，通过从车顶箱折叠下来的柔性太阳能板捕获能量。其特点包括：

- 配备27马力电动机、四轮驱动和标准后置PTO及三点悬挂。
- 在阳光下晒一天可提供约1小时的运行时间。
- 完全依靠太阳能充电需要数天。
- 售价19,995美元。

**喷雾无人机**

Revolution Drones公司的Independence 19无人机在本届农场进步展上亮相，其78%的部件在美国制造。特点包括：

- 配备20加仑药箱和三块电池。
- 每小时可覆盖60至80英亩，喷幅35至45英尺。
- 可选配撒播箱用于播种覆盖作物。
- 售价46,250美元。

**播种期种子处理系统**

TeeJet和Inflexion Point Technologies联合推出的POP-ST是业内首款处方型播种期种子处理系统，特点如下：

- 可连接任何品牌和型号的播种机。
- 在播种期间对种子进行处理，仅施加所需用量。
- 每台售价略高于10万美元。

**实时施药系统**

Case IH SenseApply是一种安装在喷雾机驾驶室顶部的相机系统：

- 相机可看到喷雾路径前方120至130英尺。
- NDVI检测生物量。
- 实时变量施药。
